acceptanceCriteria.summary: Workbench exposes bounded continuation only for supported fresh matching controlled Scheduler gates.
Action payload carries change, Goal Loop, current gate, concrete target ids, and maxSteps.
Server revalidation rejects stale, missing, forged, cross-change, unsupported, or mismatched targets.
One confirmation creates scoped authorization/run records and child iterations reference them.
Child iterations dispatch only the existing controlled Scheduler advance wrapper after re-reading evidence.
Child iterations preserve target validation, current-action revalidation, ToolPolicy audit, and Scheduler guards.
Runtime stops at budget, terminal gates, blockers, source safety, stale targets, unsupported gates, or failures.
Workbench suppresses duplicate selected-demand primary confirmations while continuation is running.
User copy describes bounded continuation and does not advertise future automation capabilities.
